claim_text: The paper compares texturing methods using asymmetric dataset sizes (diffusion ~5000, random ~300). Any method-comparison claim requires a fairness justification or a symmetric control. Without it, the superiority claim is not supported.

predicates.natural_language: When comparing method A vs B, both must have the same resource budget (dataset size, epochs, model capacity) OR the asymmetry must be explicitly declared and controlled for.
